html:
SMTO-SKL-0095 — That Microsoft account name isn't in a form SMTO accepts

GUID: 96931ab5-319e-55d7-8e25-d4df3763c102
Slug: microsoft365-parameter-reference-invalid
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: microsoft365

What happened

  • The name given for the Microsoft account or app isn't a valid saved-entry name, for example it has spaces or capital letters. SMTO didn't look anything up or contact Microsoft.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the Agent to list your Microsoft 365 accounts, and use the account name it shows. The list shows the exact saved names SMTO accepts.
  2. Or open Parameter Store, select the Microsoft entry, and select Copy reference to copy its exact name. Copying avoids typing mistakes such as spaces or capital letters.
  3. If you're naming a new account, use only lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or dots, like work_microsoft, then ask the Agent again. Saved names can't contain spaces, capitals or other symbols.

What success looks like

  • The Agent finds the account and carries on with the request.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, along with the account name you meant to use.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • account_key rejected the supplied Microsoft account or app reference because it is not a canonical Parameter Store key (optional leading @, then 1-160 characters of lowercase a-z, 0-9, underscore or dot, starting with a letter or digit).

What this means

  • Microsoft account-key parsing rejects the supplied Parameter Store reference. This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Microsoft account-key parsing rejects the supplied Parameter Store reference.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect reference syntax and normalized key rather than a credential value.

How to fix it

  • Pass the exact Parameter Store key (matching [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.]{0,159}, optionally prefixed with @) as account_ref, account_key or auth_app_ref. Use the account_ref values returned by microsoft365.accounts or the key copied from /parameter-editor; display names and email addresses are not accepted.
  • Supply the exact supported Parameter Store account key or reference shown by account discovery.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect provider state and exact account authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended exact supported account reference resolves.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
